outcome: Amount of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) during cesarean section
cohort: 6,144 individuals with PPH who underwent cesarean section
finding: Random forest machine learning model effectively predicts the amount of PPH during cesarean section with a mean absolute error of 21.7 (less than 5.4% prediction error) and a root mean squared error of 33.75 (less than 9.3% prediction error).
